description: Conformance corpus for standards/web-client.md. 'validity': the value must validate (or fail) against the named schema root — 'runtime-config' or 'error-report'. 'behaviour': black-box cases a live client and its serving process must satisfy; the harness drives the stimulus and asserts 'expect'. An implementation passes the whole file or names the case it fails.

validity.note: the whole document a BFF client needs: where the API is, how to start and end a session, and what it is running (WC1, WC2)
the same bundle, same commit, different environment — which is the WC2 property the whole rule exists for
the closed property set is the enforcement of 'nothing secret goes here' — this document is served to every anonymous visitor (WC2)
without version and commit an error report cannot say which bundle produced it (WC2, WC5)
a login path resolved against the current route sends the user somewhere different depending on where they were when the session expired
RFC 10017 defines three patterns and the implicit flow is not among them (WC1)

value.message: POST /v1/subscriptions was rejected: plan_id is required

validity.note: the report names the operation and this occurrence's reason, and carries the id that joins it to the server's log (WC5)

value.message: reading 'total' of undefined while rendering the invoice summary
value.stack: TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined\n    at InvoiceSummary (main-4f2a.js:1:20481)

validity.note: no request_id, correctly — nothing was asked of the server, so there is none to carry. The route is a PATTERN, not the resolved path with the invoice id in it

value.message: POST /v1/subscriptions was rejected: plan_id is required

validity.note: the conditional requirement: an api_error without the server's request id cannot be joined to anything, which is the whole correlation mechanism WC5 relies on

value.message: reading 'total' of undefined while rendering the invoice summary
value.stack: TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined

validity.note: browsers hold stale bundles longer than servers hold stale builds; a trace against unknown source is unreadable (WC5)

value.message: reading 'total' of undefined while rendering the invoice summary

validity.note: the closed property set is what stops a reporter shipping the user's form to a third party. This is the case the shape exists for (WC5)

value.message: invoice total did not match the sum of its lines

validity.note: presentation is for the viewer, never for the wire — the client formats for display and still sends the base form (WC4, IP4)

behaviour.stimulus: grep the built bundle for the api_base_url of any environment
behaviour.note: the WC2 gate, and the cheapest in this standard: one artifact promoted through environments, so the value cannot be in it

behaviour.stimulus: serve the identical build output from a staging server and a production server

expect.each_client: fetches a runtime config naming its own environment and api_base_url

behaviour.note: the property WC2 is actually protecting; a build-time bake fails here and nowhere else

behaviour.stimulus: complete a login and inspect the Set-Cookie header
behaviour.note: the observable half of WC1 — HttpOnly is what puts the credential out of reach of injected script

behaviour.stimulus: complete a login, then read localStorage and sessionStorage
behaviour.note: under WC1's default the browser never receives a token at all, so there is nothing to store; this catches a client that reverted to a browser-based flow without saying so

behaviour.stimulus: make a mutating call that fails with 503, and let the client retry
behaviour.note: a fresh key on the retry defeats the mechanism entirely and duplicates the charge (WC3, HA6)
the exponent belongs to the currency; dividing by 100 is wrong for JPY and for every three-exponent currency (WC4, IP5)

behaviour.stimulus: render the instant 2026-01-01T03:00:00.000Z as a date, with the viewer's zone set to America/Los_Angeles
behaviour.note: the calendar day an instant falls on depends on the zone; rendering the UTC date directly is off by one for a predictable fraction of users every day (WC4)
